title: One-at-a-Time Quantum Guessing: Multipartite Entanglement Beyond MoE Games
summary: Multipartite entanglement remains a challenging and not fully understood aspect of quantum information. Monogamy-of-Entanglement (MoE) games have been highly effective for studying limitations on the usefulness of entanglement imposed by monogamy constraints. To better reveal the extent to which multipartite entanglement can be useful, we introduce a class of quantum guessing games, termed One-at-a-Time Guessing (OTG) games.
